rules.statement: A fidei commissum does not fail by reason of the death of the fiduciary before the testator, nor because the fiduciary refuses to adiate. In such a case, the fidei commissary heir or legatee will be entitled to the burdened property forthwith, unless payment is in terms of the will necessarily postponed.
rules.supporting_quote: "A fidei commissum does not fail by reason of the death of the fiduciary before the testator, nor because the fiduciary refuses to adiate. In such a case the fidei commissary heir or legatee will be entitled to the burdened property forthwith, unless payment is in terms of the will necessarily postponed, e.g., where all the fidei commissaries cannot then be ascertained." - Steyn (Law of Wills in South Africa p. 221)
